liebermann.description_de: Vorlage von D, O und In Cn für Geþyncðo, Norðleod, Mirce, Að, Had
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of D, O and the Instituta Cnuti, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.notes: A common source of D, O and the Instituta Cnuti for these tracts, as against the other class followed by H and lq, posited by Liebermann.

entries.text_de: Vorlage von D, O und In Cn für Geþyncðo, Norðleod, Mirce, Að, Had, im Gegensatz zur anderen Classe, der H und lq folgen.
entries.text_en: Exemplar of D, O and In Cn for Geþyncðo, Norðleod, Mirce, Að, Had, in contrast to the other class, which H and lq follow.
